findings.one_line: Centering is neither a member condition of def:exact-support-model-class/def:zero-allowed-model-class nor consumed by any reproduced proof; remove it or add it consistently to the stated population class (and center the diagnostic construction).

cited_checks.note: The attested Rado Theorem 1 is exactly the independent-transversal iff dimension condition for the finite subspace family used here.
The attested Cramer decomposition theorem gives the required conclusion that a nonconstant independent summand of a Gaussian finite sum is Gaussian.
The attested ICA source covers the square invertible, all-non-Gaussian specialization, yielding columns and inverse projective rows up to permutation and nonzero scaling.

The attested Basu block-elimination statement supplies equivalent quantifier-free output, arithmetic complexity, and integer bit-size control; the displayed two-block bound is a valid coarse specialization after enlarging the absolute exponent.
